Bulacan.sourceTitle: Republic Act No. 11546, as applied in COMELEC Resolution No. 10707
Bulacan.basis: The law and COMELEC implementing rules enumerate the municipalities and cities in Bulacan's six legislative districts, effective for the 2022 elections.
Bulacan.limits: Exact locality names only; does not resolve project titles that omit a municipality or name multiple localities.

Batangas.basis: The statute enumerates Batangas municipalities and cities in six legislative districts.
Batangas.limits: Exact locality names only; named projects spanning multiple municipalities are not assigned to a single district by this crosswalk.

Albay.sourceTitle: Pocket Size Rules of the Senate, January 29, 2026
Albay.basis: The Senate's current district composition lists the municipalities in Albay's three legislative districts.
Albay.limits: Exact locality names only; excludes Legazpi City from municipal mapping because it is a separate roster jurisdiction.

Quezon.sourceTitle: Pocket Size Rules of the Senate, January 29, 2026
Quezon.basis: The Senate's current district composition lists the municipalities in Quezon's four legislative districts.
Quezon.limits: Exact locality names only. Lucena City remains in its own roster jurisdiction and is not used as a Quezon municipality override.

Davao de Oro.basis: Section 2 expressly states that Monkayo, Compostela, New Bataan, Montevista and Maragusan are in the First Legislative District.
Davao de Oro.limits: Only the five municipalities explicitly identified by the Act are overridden. Other Davao de Oro localities remain subject to crosswalk agreement.

Leyte.sourceTitle: Pocket Size Rules of the Senate, January 29, 2026
Leyte.basis: The Senate's current district composition lists the municipalities in Leyte's five legislative districts.
Leyte.limits: Exact locality names only; Tacloban and Ormoc City are handled through their separately rostered city jurisdictions.

Pangasinan.sourceTitle: Pocket Size Rules of the Senate, January 29, 2026
Pangasinan.basis: The Senate's current district composition enumerates the municipalities and cities in Pangasinan's six districts.
Pangasinan.limits: Exact province-qualified municipality/city names only; titles with no exact locality or multiple localities remain unresolved.

Cagayan.sourceTitle: Pocket Size Rules of the Senate, January 29, 2026
Cagayan.basis: The Senate's current district composition enumerates the municipalities and city in Cagayan's three districts.
Cagayan.limits: Exact province-qualified municipality/city names only; titles with no exact locality or multiple localities remain unresolved.

Pampanga.basis: The Senate's district composition enumerates the municipalities and city in Pampanga's four districts; the list matches the current House roster's four seats.
Pampanga.limits: Exact province-qualified municipality/city names only; titles with no exact locality or multiple localities remain unresolved.

Tarlac.basis: The Senate's district composition enumerates Tarlac's municipalities and city in three districts; the list matches the current House roster.
Tarlac.limits: Exact province-qualified municipality/city names only; titles with no exact locality or multiple localities remain unresolved.

Nueva Ecija.basis: The Senate's district composition enumerates Nueva Ecija's municipalities and cities in four districts; the list matches the current House roster.
Nueva Ecija.limits: Exact province-qualified municipality/city names only; titles with no exact locality or multiple localities remain unresolved.

Laguna.basis: The Senate's district composition enumerates Laguna's municipalities and cities in four districts; the list matches the current House roster.
Laguna.limits: Exact province-qualified municipality/city names only; titles with no exact locality or multiple localities remain unresolved.

Cebu.sourceTitle: Province of Cebu official district directory; Republic Act No. 10684 for the Seventh District
Cebu.basis: The current Province of Cebu directory enumerates localities in seven districts; RA 10684 expressly assigns the Seventh District municipalities.
Cebu.limits: Exact Cebu-province municipality/city names only. Cebu City and the separately rostered Lapu-Lapu and Mandaue cities remain under their own city attribution rules.

Iloilo.sourceTitle: Pocket Size Rules of the Senate, January 29, 2026
Iloilo.basis: The Senate's current district composition enumerates localities in Iloilo's five legislative districts.
Iloilo.limits: Exact province-qualified locality names only. A multi-locality or incomplete project scope is not reduced to one district by this crosswalk.

Negros Occidental.sourceTitle: Pocket Size Rules of the Senate, January 29, 2026
Negros Occidental.basis: The Senate's current district composition enumerates municipalities and cities in Negros Occidental's six legislative districts.
Negros Occidental.limits: Exact province-qualified locality names only. A multi-locality or incomplete project scope is not reduced to one district by this crosswalk.

Bohol.sourceTitle: Pocket Size Rules of the Senate, January 29, 2026
Bohol.basis: The Senate's current district composition enumerates municipalities and Tagbilaran City in Bohol's three legislative districts.
Bohol.limits: Exact province-qualified locality names only. A multi-locality or incomplete project scope is not reduced to one district by this crosswalk.

Camarines Sur.basis: RA 9716 creates the current five-district arrangement. It assigns the old fourth district unchanged as the fifth district, including Iriga City and Baao, Balatan, Bato, Buhi, Bula and Nabua.
Camarines Sur.limits: Exact province-qualified locality names only; cross-boundary projects and incomplete or conflicting locality scopes remain unresolved.

Bukidnon.sourceTitle: COMELEC Resolution No. 9539 implementing Republic Act No. 10184
Bukidnon.basis: COMELEC Resolution No. 9539 lists the exact municipalities in Bukidnon legislative districts after RA 10184; the current House roster retains four seats.
Bukidnon.limits: Only the locality name explicitly included here is overridden; other Bukidnon localities continue to require both local maps to agree.

Misamis Occidental.basis: The Act expressly identifies Ozamiz City as part of the Second Legislative District of Misamis Occidental.
Misamis Occidental.limits: Applies only to the named city; no inference from its DPWH engineering office is made for other locations.
